rows.grounds: gerund of vi-hā; introduces abandonment of straightness
compound adjective modifying satī; struck by staff of own will
present participle of as; subject of yāti

items.question: What becomes of a being who abandons straightness when struck by own-will staff?
premises: straightness is abandoned by the being
items.inference: abandoning straightness under self-will causes the being to go
uncertainties: exact doctrinal referent of own-will staff remains unclear
items.plain_english: Having abandoned straightness, being struck by the staff of her own will, she goes.
